nodes.description: Owned.owner: primary owner address with onlyOwner rights
Owned.newOwner: pending owner awaiting acceptOwnership
Owned.admin: secondary privileged address, owner is admin by default
_totalSupply: total NOM supply, mutated by payout, redenominate and updateAccount
frozen: emergency stop flag checked by nearly every state-changing function
round: redenomination round counter used for decimal scaling
epoch: season counter controlling funds and voting eligibility
team_fund: accumulated 10% team fund, withdrawable by owner
redenom_dao_fund: accumulated 30% DAO fund, withdrawable by owner
epoch_fund: emission pool paid out to users in the current epoch
accounts: mapping address=>Account holding balance, lastRound, lastVotedEpoch, bitmask
allowed: ERC20 allowance mapping owner=>spender=>amount
votingActive: gate for the onlyVoter modifier and ballot functions
projects: dynamic array of Project structs used by the ballot
dec[8]: per-digit burned/unclaimed decimal ledger refreshed by renewDec
current_toadd[9]: per-digit dividend amounts computed by redenominate and consumed by updateAccount
decimals: token precision, fixed at 8
total_fund: long-term fund pool decreased on each new epoch
mul[9]: powers-of-ten multiplier table indexed by round
Owned(): constructor assigning deployer as owner and admin
setAdmin(address) onlyOwner: replaces the admin address
transferOwnership(address) onlyOwner: stages newOwner (two-step ownership)
acceptOwnership(): newOwner must call to complete ownership handover
StartNewEpoch() onlyAdmin: requires round==9, resets dec, bumps epoch, refunds epoch_fund
addProject(uint) onlyAdmin: pushes a new ballot Project
swapProject(uint) onlyAdmin: toggles project active flag
vote(uint) onlyVoter: adds sqrt(balance) weight to a project
enableVoting() onlyAdmin: requires round==9, opens the ballot
disableVoting() onlyAdmin: closes the ballot
pay1(address) onlyAdmin: pays 1 NOM to a KYC user and sets bit 4
pay055(address) onlyAdmin: pays 0.555666XX where XX derives from block.timestamp
pay055loyal(address) onlyAdmin: epoch>1 payout derived from block.timestamp
payCustom(address,uint) onlyOwner: arbitrary owner-initiated payout
payout(address,uint) private: core emission routine updating balances, funds, _totalSupply and dec
withdraw_team_fund(address,uint) onlyOwner: moves team_fund into a balance
withdraw_dao_fund(address,uint) onlyOwner: moves redenom_dao_fund into a balance
freeze_contract() onlyOwner: sets frozen=true
unfreeze_contract() onlyOwner: sets frozen=false
renewDec(uint,uint) internal: recomputes dec[] digit ledger on balance change
bitmask_add(address,uint) internal: sets a permission bit on an account
bitmask_rm(address,uint) internal: clears a permission bit
bitmask_check(address,uint) internal view: permission/KYC/ban lookup with broken precedence
ban_user(address) onlyAdmin: sets the 1024 ban bit
unban_user(address) onlyAdmin: clears the 1024 ban bit
redenominate() onlyAdmin: core redenomination logic recomputing funds, dec and current_toadd
updateAccount(address) public: pays round dividends and truncates balances
current_mul() internal view: returns mul[round-1]
fix_amount(uint) public view: truncates an amount to the current multiplier
transfer(address,uint): ERC20 transfer with ban check, fixes amount and renews dec
approve(address,uint): ERC20 approval with ban check
transferFrom(address,address,uint): ERC20 delegated transfer updating allowance and balances
approveAndCall(address,uint,bytes): sets allowance then calls spender.receiveApproval
transferAnyERC20Token(address,uint) onlyOwner: arbitrary external token transfer
fallback function: reverts all plain ETH transfers
SafeMath.add(uint,uint): overflow-checked addition
SafeMath.sub(uint,uint): underflow-checked subtraction
msg.sender: caller used for ownership, admin, ban, KYC and voting checks
block.timestamp: miner-influenceable time used to derive payout amounts
External call to attacker-controlled spender.receiveApproval before returning
External call to arbitrary tokenAddress.transfer(owner,tokens)
Amount derived from block.timestamp%100, miner-manipulable payout value
accounts[user].bitmask & _bit == 0 parses as bitmask & (_bit==0), corrupting all permission checks
Raw multiply/divide/modulo decimal and fund arithmetic in payout, redenominate and updateAccount
payout(address to): recipient address
payout(uint amount): requested raw amount
setAdmin(address newAdmin): replacement admin
transferOwnership(address _newOwner): staged owner
payout local fixedAmount: truncated payout value
bitmask_check(address user): account queried for a permission bit
updateAccount local tempDividedBalance: balance pre-truncation value
approveAndCall(address spender): callee of the external callback
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress): arbitrary external token address
redenominate local ke9[9]: per-digit redistribution values

normalization_plan.reason: The payout recipient parameter is only meaningful inside payout; merge it into the payout function node that performs the credit.
The raw payout amount parameter is scaled and spent entirely inside payout; fold it into the payout function node.
newAdmin is a transient argument whose only effect is the admin write in setAdmin; merge into setAdmin.
_newOwner only feeds the newOwner state write inside transferOwnership; merge into transferOwnership.
fixedAmount is a payout-local intermediate that ends up in balances and funds; merge into the payout function node.
The user parameter only selects the account inspected by bitmask_check; merge into the bitmask_check function node.
tempDividedBalance is an updateAccount-local scaling intermediate; merge into the updateAccount function node.
spender is the untrusted address that becomes the external callback target; merge into the receiveApproval external-call unsafe operation.
tokenAddress is the untrusted contract targeted by the external transfer; merge into the ERC20 external-call unsafe operation.
ke9 is a redenominate-local scratch array used to build current_toadd; merge into the redenominate function node.
